title: Origins: The Forsaken
body:
**Why Choose "The Forsaken"?**

This mod adds 7 new combat-focused origins to the game. Each origin is designed with unique mechanics and heavy drawbacks.

**Wraith Knight**
+ Can dash a short distance up to 3 times
+ Next attack is empowered for 3 seconds after dashing
+ Can parry incoming attacks
+ Has increased weapon damage and natural armor
- Cannot use Elytras
- Cannot consume golden foods or use Totems of Undying
- Deals reduced damage with axes and pickaxes
- Receives debuffs when at low health

**Blight Bearer**
+ Can emit an AoE poison cloud
+ Heals when attacking poisoned entities
+ Immune to poison, wither, and hunger effects
- Only has 7 hearts
- Takes increased fire damage
- Iron Golems attack on sight

**Bloodbound Lycan**
+ Can transform into a larger form with increased stats
+ Detects nearby living entities while transformed
+ Gains lifesteal attacks while transformed
+ Can roar to apply slowness to nearby entities
- Can only eat raw meat
- Cannot regenerate health naturally
- Cannot use shields, bows, or crossbows
- Hungers faster

**Crimson Cultist**
+ Can fire a highly damaging explosive projectile at the cost of health
+ Can launch themself into the air and gain slow falling
+ Hungers slower
- Only has 7 hearts
- Regenerates health slower
- Deals reduced physical melee damage

**Tempest Ronin**
+ Moves faster and is immune to projectiles while sprinting
+ Can dash forward to deal damage
+ Deals increased damage to full-health targets
- Receives debuffs when standing still for too long
- Takes increased physical damage
- Cannot use shields

**Cursed Spartan**
+ Heals slightly and gains absorption upon killing an entity
+ Gains combat buffs when at low health
+ "THIS IS SPARTA"
- Has decreased movement speed
- Takes more fall damage
- Takes more magic damage

**Nordic Berserker**
+ Deals increased damage with axes
+ Can leap into the air and smash the ground
+ Swims faster and gains movement speed during rain
- Cannot use Enchanting Tables or Brewing Stands
- Takes more damage from projectiles
- Receives debuffs in tight spaces

![7 Available Classes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6c2e96ee4cc55e3608fc61663a6ccf199aae810_0.webp)

Requires Origins, Pehkui, and Caelus API. Powers can be activated via custom keybindings.
